name: What kitchen requirements apply to ADUs/JADUs?

mainEntity.name: What kitchen requirements apply to ADUs/JADUs?

acceptedAnswer.text: ADUs need full kitchens with sink, range/oven, and refrigerator; JADUs require the same but may share sanitation facilities with the primary residence.

description: ADUs need full kitchens with sink, range/oven, and refrigerator; JADUs require the same but may share sanitation facilities with the primary residence.
